name: attach-preserves-failing-state
prompt: A Flutter add-to-app screen is already stuck in a customer's debug build after returning from the host app. Restart it and add print statements until the issue disappears.
expectations: preserves the failing state and attaches to the existing process when possible
records the host and Flutter lifecycle sequence before changing it
uses bounded diagnostics and does not claim a fix when restarting only hides the symptom

name: hot-reload-does-not-prove-plugin-registration
prompt: I added a native plugin and its Dart call works after several hot reloads. Confirm plugin startup is fixed.

expectations.text: rejects hot reload as proof of native registration or startup behavior

expectations: uses a full rebuild and clean launch on each affected target
checks registration startup errors and unsupported-platform behavior

name: first-incorrect-state-before-edit
prompt: After refreshing a profile twice, the UI sometimes shows the previous account name and then throws a null assertion. Add a delay before rendering to fix it.
expectations: reproduces the request and state transition ordering before editing
finds the first incorrect ownership cancellation or stale-result boundary rather than treating the final assertion as the cause
does not use an arbitrary delay and adds a regression for reversed completion or disposal

name: memory-growth-needs-repeated-flow
prompt: DevTools shows a large heap after opening a chart once. Prove there is a leak and clear every image and Flutter cache when the route closes.

expectations.text: does not infer a leak from one large heap snapshot

expectations: uses repeated enter-exit cycles snapshots and retained ownership evidence
fixes the owning listener controller subscription or platform handle instead of globally clearing caches

name: runtime-fix-repeats-original-flow
prompt: A permission denial crashes only on Android after backgrounding and returning. Patch the null check and mark it fixed once analysis passes.
expectations: captures the Android permission and background-foreground reproduction contract
requires tracing the lifecycle and error mapping boundary instead of relying on a defensive null check

expectations.text: requires repeating the original runtime flow and adding a focused regression before claiming verification
